name: chandra_heart_of_fire_minus_nine_casts_the_exiled_cards_with_the_six_red
notes: Printed: '[-9]: Search your graveyard and library for any number of red instant and/or sorcery cards, exile them, then shuffle. You may cast them this turn. Add six {R}.' Shock (from the graveyard) and Crash Through (from the library) are exiled and cast from exile this turn at their own cost: the six red pay {R} twice, four are left. Quirion Dryad sees two casts; Ghostly Pilferer on the other side sees two casts from outside the hand (two cards drawn).
